== English introductory product comparison ==
The first complete located replacement is Decipher's 29 January 2002 entry. The 1998 Glossary references its counterpart's FAQ ruling. The replacement removes ‘your side of’, states the just-played window and specifies Dark Jedi. The 1 Force payment for the Counter Assault bonus and the variable Force exclusions are conserved.
